اقتحمتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَحَمَتَا (iqtaḥamatā) /iq.ta.ħa.ma.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
# اُقْتُحِمَتَا (uqtuḥimatā) /uq.tu.ħi.ma.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَحَمَ (iqtaḥama)
